twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Signing in asks for a code from an authenticator app in addition to your password.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code to scan with an authenticator app
twoFactor.step1: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app or enter the key manually.
twoFactor.step2: Enter the 6-digit code shown by the app and confirm.
twoFactor.recoveryOnce: These codes are shown only now. Store them somewhere safe; you need them to sign in if you lose your phone.
twoFactor.copied: Recovery codes copied to the clipboard.
twoFactor.copyFailed: Could not copy; write the codes down manually.
twoFactor.passwordHint: For your security the password is asked again and is never stored.
twoFactor.startBody: Confirm your current password to start two-step verification setup.
twoFactor.disableBody: Enter your current password to confirm. Your account will be protected by the password only.
